recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future changes to the extension definition should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack, while core should keep Patient.multipleBirth[x] aligned with that canonical extension.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive Patient Administration request to introduce an integer extension on Patient.multipleBirth[x] for the total number of births from one pregnancy, enabling representations such as the 4 in "3 of 4".
initial_application: Core commit 0bcf5a628352f8e84a7dc1d3fac6fa9bca0cbe1b added StructureDefinition/patient-multipleBirthTotal under source/patient and listed it in the Patient implementation guide. Commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 later removed Patient extension definitions from core as part of moving global extensions out of the R5 source tree.
additional_context: The active core Patient resource definition now points Patient.multipleBirth[x] to the patient-multipleBirthTotal extension. The FHIR Extension Pack contains the canonical extension with Patient.multipleBirth[x] context and positiveInt value. Later Patient Administration decisions FHIR-41244 and FHIR-48399 clarified the extension and Patient.multipleBirth[x] wording for fetal losses and pre-birth use, and those clarifications are present in current source.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because no current core source change is required. Re-adding the extension XML to core would duplicate the Extension Pack source of truth, and the active core Patient definition plus OID entry preserve the needed reference.

related_jiras.note: Clarified that Patient.multipleBirth[x] and patient-multipleBirthTotal counts include live births and fetal losses.
Clarified pre-birth multiple-fetus usage for Patient.multipleBirth[x] and patient-multipleBirthTotal.
A vital-records IG adopted patient-multipleBirthTotal for Patient plurality, confirming downstream use of the extension.
